annotations.title: Create a t-shirt design from a prompt

description: Generate an apparel print design (a wordmark, crest, icon or illustrated graphic) from a text prompt: one model call plans the copy and — unless the budget is out — one hero graphic, then buildTshirt composes it on a TRANSPARENT ground and previews it on light and dark garments (the palette re-derives per garment so the ink reads on each). Returns the new artifact id: read/edit it with read_artifact, redraw it with reroll_artifact, download the print-ready 300-DPI transparent PNG with export_artifact. Any free-tier degradation comes back as a warning.

direction.description: Free-form creative direction for the outline

prompt.description: What goes on the shirt — the slogan/subject, audience, and any dates or place

styleId.description: A curated Style id from list_styles. Default the first curated Style.
